summary_1line: Pandavas rise to power, Arjuna gains Subhadra and Gandiva, Maya builds their palace, Duryodhana’s envy leads to dice exile; Janamejaya asks for the full story.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna and Krishna stand beside the blazing Khandava forest as Agni rises in flames and presents Arjuna the radiant bow Gandiva and an inexhaustible quiver.
The Asura Maya, saved from the fire, bows gratefully before the Pandavas and begins constructing a dazzling jewel-studded celestial palace.
Duryodhana gazes with burning envy at the magnificent crystal-like palace of the Pandavas, its jeweled halls reflecting light around him.
